ways.label: Flora car park to Mt Arthur Summit

via.name: junction with the route across Horseshoe Basin
track junction just below Winter Peak

ways.time: 3 hr 30 min - 4 hr 30 min one way
ways.distance: 9.2 km one way return via same track
evidence: Follow the Mt Arthur Hut Walk from Flora car park to Mt Arthur Hut.
The Mt Arthur Summit Route skirts around the back of Winter Peak, then climbs steeply to the Mt Arthur Summit – expect to be scrambling up rocky terrain.

doubts: No feature for Flora car park, so the start has no ref. Shape out and back from DOC's distance 'return via same track'. The route skirts around the back of Winter Peak rather than over it, so Winter Peak itself is not listed in via.
